profile_text.body:
Otter.ai is a software company whose flagship product, also called Otter.ai, provides AI-powered meeting assistance. According to its website, the core offering centers on the Otter AI Meeting Agent, which supports real-time transcription, live chat, automated summaries, insights, and action items. The company describes flexible recording options including an automatic AI Notetaker that joins meetings, a bot-free desktop and Chrome recorder, and a mobile capture tool.

The site also highlights Otter AI Chat, which searches across meetings and connected apps to answer questions and help users produce follow-ups, reports, and other content. A branded assistant called OtterPilot is presented as a smart AI meeting assistant. Otter.ai additionally offers an MCP Server that allows external AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, to access a user's meeting knowledge for analysis and workflow purposes. The Wall Street Journal is cited on the site as recognizing Otter.ai as a must-try AI tool.

The reference data held on this site categorizes Otter.ai under Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings, and flags meeting transcription as the primary use case with a note that consent considerations are relevant to its use. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
